blurb: Blue Dolphin Cruises offers some of the most spectacular views on the Gulf Coast, including Orange Beach, Gulf Shores, and Perdido Key. Captain Buddy and his crew are happy to show you the perfect spots to catch a glimpse of Perdido Key, FL natives: dolphins!
